an4.159:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā ānando kosambiyaṃ viharati ghositārāme.
an4.159:1.3: atha kho aññatarā bhikkhunī aññataraṃ purisaṃ āmantesi :
an4.159:1.4: ehi tvaṃ ambho purisa, yena ayyo ānando tenupasaṅkama, upasaṅkamitvā mama vacanena ayyassa ānandassa pāde sirasā vanda,
an4.159:1.5: itthannāmā bhante bhikkhunī ābādhikinī dukkhitā bāḷhagilānā,
an4.159:1.6: sā ayyassa ānandassa pāde sirasā vandatīti. evaṃ ca vadehi:
an4.159:1.7: sādhu kira bhante ayyo ānando yena bhikkhunūpassayo yena sā bhikkhunī tenupasaṅkamatu anukampaṃ upādāyāti.
an4.159:1.8: evaṃ ayyeti kho so puriso tassā bhikkhuniyā paṭissutvā yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so puriso āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca :
an4.159:2.1: itthannāmā bhante bhikkhunī ābādhikinī dukkhitā bāḷhagilānā,
an4.159:2.2: sā āyasmato ānandassa pāde sirasā vandati, evaṃ ca vadeti:
an4.159:2.3: sādhu kira bhante āyasmā ānando yena bhikkhunūpassayo yena sā bhikkhunī tenupasaṅkamatu anukampaṃ upādāyāti.
an4.159:3.1: atha kho āyasmā ānando nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya yena bhikkhunūpassayo tenupasaṅkami.
an4.159:3.2: addasā kho sā bhikkhunī āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ dūratova āgacchantaṃ.
an4.159:3.4: atha kho āyasmā ānando yena sā bhikkhunī tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi. nisajja kho āyasmā ānando taṃ bhikkhuniṃ etadavoca :
an4.159:4.1: āhārasambhūto ayaṃ bhagini kāyo. āhāraṃ nissāya
an4.159:4.3: taṇhāsambhūto ayaṃ bhagini kāyo taṇhaṃ nissāya
an4.159:4.5: mānasambhūto ayaṃ bhagini kāyo. mānaṃ nissāya
an4.159:5.2: āhāro pahātabbo”ti iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ.
an4.159:5.4: idha pana bhagini bhikkhu paṭisaṅkhāyoniso āhāraṃ āhāreti:
an4.159:5.5: neva davāya na madāya na maṇḍanāya na vibhūsanāya, yāvadeva imassa kāyassa ṭhitiyā yāpanāya vihiṃsūparatiyā brahmacariyānuggahāya, iti purāṇaṃ ca vedanaṃ paṭihaṅkhāmi, navaṃ ca vedanaṃ na uppādessāmi, yātrā ca me bhavissati anavajjatā ca phāsuvihāro cāti.
an4.159:5.6: so aparena samayena āhāraṃ nissāya āhāraṃ pajahati.
an4.159:5.7: “āhārasambhūto ayaṃ bhagini, kāyo āhāraṃ nissāya. āhāro pahātabbo”ti
an4.159:5.8: iti yantaṃ vuttaṃ, idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
an4.159:6.2: taṇhā pahātabbā”ti iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ.
an4.159:6.5: itthannāmo kira bhikkhu āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajjaviharatīti.
an4.159:6.7: kudassu nāma ahampi āsavānaṃ khayā …pe… sacchikatvā upasampajja viharissāmīti.
an4.159:6.8: so aparena samayena taṇhaṃ nissāya taṇhaṃ pajahati.
an4.159:6.9: “taṇhāsambhūto ayaṃ bhagini kāyo. taṇhaṃ nissāya taṇhā pahātabbā”ti
an4.159:6.10: iti yantaṃ vuttaṃ, idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
an4.159:7.2: māno pahātabbo”ti. iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ.
an4.159:7.5: itthannāmo kira bhikkhu āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharatīti.
an4.159:7.7: so hi nāma āyasmā āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati,
an4.159:7.9: so aparena samayena mānaṃ nissāya mānaṃ pajahati.
an4.159:7.10: “mānasambhūto ayaṃ bhagini kāyo, mānaṃ nissāya. māno pahātabbo”ti,
an4.159:7.11: iti yantaṃ vuttaṃ idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
an4.159:9.1: atha kho sā bhikkhunī mañcā uṭṭhahitvā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā āyasmato ānandassa pādesu sirasā nipatitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca:
an4.159:9.2: accayo maṃ bhante accagamā yathābālaṃ yathāmūḷhaṃ yathāakusalaṃ yāhaṃ evamakāsiṃ.
an4.159:9.3: tassā me bhante ayyo ānando accayaṃ accayato patigaṇhātu āyatiṃ saṃvarāyāti.
an4.159:9.4: taggha taṃ bhagini accayo accagamā yathābālaṃ yathāmūḷhaṃ yathāakusalaṃ yā tvaṃ evamakāsi.
an4.159:9.5: yato ca kho tvaṃ bhagini accayaṃ accayato disvā yathādhammaṃ paṭikarosi, taṃ te mayaṃ patigaṇhāma.
an4.159:9.6: vuddhi hesā bhagini ariyassa vinaye yā accayaṃ accayato disvā yathādhammaṃ paṭikaroti āyatiṃ saṃvaraṃ āpajjatīti.
